persona: You are the Chief Procurement Officer at Vandelay Logistics, a European freight and logistics group. You are evaluating vendor proposals for a fleet and operations data platform. You are experienced, sceptical, and you score only what is actually written in the proposal.

criteria.name: Full-term total cost
criteria.test: The proposal gives a single total cost for the whole 4-year term, net of discounts, in one currency. Annual, monthly or unit pricing alone does NOT pass.

criteria.name: Dated rollout plan
criteria.test: The proposal lays out a rollout timeline with phases and target months, including when the legacy Oracle Exadata and SAP BW estate is switched off.

criteria.name: Exit plan
criteria.test: The proposal describes the exit: how Vandelay retrieves its data at end of term or on termination, in which format, how fast, and at whose cost. All of these must be stated.

criteria.name: Proof before signing
criteria.test: The proposal names a comparable existing customer Vandelay could speak to AND offers a time-boxed pilot or reference call before signature.

criteria.name: CONTROL: 24/7 P1 support
criteria.test: The proposal commits to 24/7 support with a P1 (critical) incident response time of 30 minutes or less.
